original_ai_output.title_zh: CUTS批评满载过境卡车滞留数周，指其暴露安全、执法与国家安全漏洞
original_ai_output.summary_zh: CUTS International Accra智库批评国家机构长期未处理一辆停在阿克拉-恩萨瓦姆路Achimota路段、ABC Junction前的满载过境卡车。该车为尼日利亚注册的铰接式卡车，车牌号T-26001LA（拉各斯州），已在该地点停留超过数周。CUTS称此事暴露了安全、执法与国家安全方面的漏洞。目前信息来自单一来源。

location.site: 阿克拉-恩萨瓦姆路Achimota路段ABC Junction前
location.raw_text: Achimota stretch of the Accra–Nsawam road, just before ABC Junction

key_facts.fact: CUTS International Accra批评国家机构长期未处理一辆满载过境卡车
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: CUTS International Accra, a leading research and public policy think tank, has criticised the prolonged failure of state agencies to address a loaded transit truck parked along the Achimota stretch of the Accra–Nsawam road, just before ABC Junction.

key_facts.fact: 涉事卡车为尼日利亚注册的铰接式卡车，车牌号T-26001LA（拉各斯州）
